description: §15.11.1 — a component forwards its bindable prop to an inner `<input bind:value=value>`. Typing into the input writes the caller's bound cell `@text` (copied to `@snap`); a later parent write to `@text` propagates into the input. The bind prop is not written onto the root as an attribute.
rationale: §15.11.1: 'Changes to `@var` in the parent SHALL propagate into the component. Changes to the bindable prop inside the component SHALL propagate back to `@var` in the parent.'
